A panel with raw, unformatted numbers is hard to read. A value of 1048576 doesn't mean much at a glance, but "1 MiB" is immediately clear. And without color-coded thresholds, you can't tell at a glance whether a value is normal or critical.

Configuring display options transforms raw data into information that anyone on your team can understand. Units, thresholds, legends, and tooltips turn a panel from a data dump into a useful monitoring tool.
In the next milestone, you set a unit and color scheme using standard options.
